detail: Bombay Sapphire cleared off the shelf for a private function and never written down anywhere. The books still carry the full case; the shelf is bare.
Two Carlsberg 30L kegs pulled from the outside cold room after a coolant fault and not recorded. The outside line goes into a heavy football night on barely one keg.
Tomer pouring Absolut roughly 18 percent heavy across his shifts. POS counts match, physical depletion does not.
Grey Goose bottle dropped at the inside bar. Mentioned in the shift group but never entered anywhere.
Havana Club broken during a rush. Nobody reported it at all.
Jameson chasers sent to a table by Roei. Shift manager, within the standard comp allowance.
Fourteen Patron shots comped by a junior bartender. Over the ten-serving limit and without manager approval.
Weihenstephan keg foaming badly, swapped out with 42 percent left. That volume is an IBBL credit, not sales.
CBC invoice says ten cases of Coca-Cola, nine arrived.
Table left without settling. Six Johnnie Walker shots poured against an open ticket.
Heineken case dropped in the cold room.
House red undercounted during a rushed close.
Hendrick's poured for a private booking, approved by Yael.
Muriel running heavy on Jack Daniel's during her first weeks.
Tuborg keg returned flat.
Two Prosecco bottles broken on New Year prep.
Red Bull delivery one flat short.
Absolut overcounted, backups double counted.
Unpaid ticket, four Chivas.
Campari knocked off the speed rack.
Bacardi running heavy through the Mojito season.
Tonic undercounted, a case left in the corridor.
